title: Change the missing calibration depth with an actual allowed endpoint experiment
statement: One Bell pair sent after r-2 paid forwards yields an ordinary Bell-label sample w_j without a native environment flag. n independent endpoint probes and a symmetric I/X likelihood decision attain exact worst-world expected additive regret R_n=(Delta/2)[1-TV(w_1^n,w_2^n)] for both losses, even against arbitrary allowed quantum calibration/decoding. n>=(2/Delta^2)log(1/eta) suffices to choose an oracle-optimal correction with probability1-eta.

requires: Supplied two candidate stationary dimension-d models, independent whole-process starts and the declared forward/test or forward/USE library
No inverse, hidden-memory control/readout, extra noise flag or uncharged wait; every forward counts
Recovery deployment is fresh independent payload/reference, identity input, r-2 forwards plus one USE, r=d^2-d+1
Allow n calibration episodes of depth r-1, one call longer than the uninformative cap
provides: An exact specialized acquisition-to-recovery interface preserving the same deployment task
assumptions: Known two-candidate Pauli endpoint family only
All Bell probes/start/wait/control and confidence precision costs paid; no actual samples acquired
costs: Short calibration episodes have at most r-2 native calls; informative episodes require r-1=d^2-d
n endpoint probes pay n starts, n(r-2) forwards, n USE calls, local Bell preparation/reference storage/readout and unchanged deployment
Algebraic finite-field/map preparation, source synthesis, finite precision and actual implementation errors remain paid
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/Bell loss/half-diamond error as explicitly stated; source calls, resets, memory and control gates are separate costs.
contract.obstruction: A proof-only classical label relaxation is not a supplied noise flag; the paid Bell experiment attains it at this interface.

evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The fixed-time identity-encoded one-use service, independent deployment start, forward-only native actions and two known candidates are substantive. There is a positive oracle noise floor and a shrinking dimension-dependent Choi margin. This is not a near-perfect recovery impossibility, total shot/computation advantage, dimension-independent mixing result or generic unknown-memory learner. Historical Jordan/tiny-signal sources and missing author checks remain separate; completed receipts bind corrected final sources. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Three separately acquired completed scoped reviews bind the two-shift physical source, corrected one-use corollary and constructive Bell-probe addendum. Pending headers are historical. No new audit, physical acquisition or novelty clearance.
